item.title: Cookie Policy
item.description:
1. What Are Cookies?

Cookies are small text files placed on your device by websites to remember information about your visit. They are widely used to make websites work, remember your preferences, and provide anonymous usage statistics.

2. Our Cookie Philosophy

At CSRGO Wishes, we believe in a privacy-first approach. We keep our use of cookies and browser storage to an absolute minimum. We do not use advertising cookies, tracking pixels, or sell any cookie-based data to third parties.

item.title: Friendship Day Magic & Surprise
item.description:
Friendship Day Magic & Surprise

Send your best friend an unforgettable interactive Friendship Day website! Packed with mini-games, secret custom wish reveals, and instant WhatsApp sharing.

Specifications & Features

  • Interactive Heart Collector Game: Catch falling friendship hearts before time runs out.
  • Scratch Card Secret Message: Reveal a hidden heartfelt or hilarious message.
  • Friendship Meter Calculator: Dynamic percentage test for your bond.
  • Confetti & Celebration: Burst of celebratory effects on page load.
  • Customizable Sender & Recipient: Add your names, custom note, and memories.

2. About Our Services

CSRGO Wishes provides digital wish-page templates for occasions such as birthdays, Friendship Day, anniversaries, and more. Our service involves:
